objective: Ensure every proposed or published AWG repository change is evaluated by the pinned Agent Workflow Quality policy.
assumptions: AWQ source is checked out at an immutable full commit SHA
AWQ checks remain offline and deterministic after source checkout
branch protection is configured separately from repository source
unknowns: Whether GitHub branch protection currently marks the AWQ job required
transitions: pass -> merge eligible only when repository policy requires the check
invariants: AWQ source revision is a full 40-character commit SHA
a missing, failed, or cancelled AWQ check is not represented as quality approval
the lock profiles and requirement set are checked by the pinned AWQ source
AWQ evidence remains separate from oracle and implementation evidence
acceptance_predicates: the workflow triggers on pull_request and main push
the workflow invokes the AWQ reusable workflow at the same immutable revision supplied as awq-ref
the workflow has a finite timeout and read-only contents permission
